title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：万亿IPO首日，普通配置者该追吗？
speaker: Adam Gold

segments.en: Can we call this IPO a success? A success for the employees, for the founders, and for the venture capitalists,
segments.zh: 这次IPO能算成功吗？对员工、创始人、风投来说，

segments.en: and the hedge funds or mutual funds who've taken this company from $0 in value to almost $2 trillion on day one,
segments.zh: 以及对冲基金或共同基金，他们让这家公司从零市值到上市首日近2万亿美元，

segments.en: unfortunate part for all the other investors who didn't have a chance to buy it, is they have to wait until this IPO comes out.
segments.zh: 对其他没机会买入的市场参与者来说，不幸的是他们得等到IPO之后。

segments.en: And this is an unfortunate part of the private markets in the last decade.
segments.zh: 这是过去十年私募市场的一个不幸之处。

segments.en: These companies, I believe, should have been public much earlier, same thing for SpaceX for this.
segments.zh: 我认为这些公司应该更早上市，SpaceX也是如此。

segments.en: And you have really got a chance to share those gains with all investors, people's retirement accounts.
segments.zh: 这样你才能真正有机会与所有市场参与者、人们的退休账户分享这些收益。

segments.en: And that's just unfortunate that they've controlled such a few people have held such this value.
segments.zh: 不幸的是，少数人控制了如此巨大的价值。

segments.en: And I think that's why there's actually a lot of backlash against some of the AI leaders, because it hasn't spread out to everyone.
segments.zh: 我认为这就是为什么一些AI领袖遭到很多反对，因为收益没有惠及所有人。

segments.en: Yeah, it's almost like when you keep the doors to the club exclusive and close to most of the public, and then you open them up for 30 in the morning, and then you get this last hurrah.
segments.zh: 是的，就像你把俱乐部大门对大多数人紧闭，然后早上30分才打开，最后狂欢一下。

segments.en: Which I guess is just my way of asking, would you buy into this?
segments.zh: 我想问的是，你会考虑参与吗？

segments.en: Would you be advising to buy into this dip on anthropic?
segments.zh: 你会建议趁anthropic回调时参与吗？

segments.en: Or how long would one wait?
